settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.http_to_https_tooltip: Redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS. The Postal web interface is meant to be used over HTTPS only: OIDC logins and secure cookies need it.
settings.initialize_postal_description: Creates the Postal database schema of a new instance, or runs the pending migrations of an existing one. Data is never removed.
settings.warning_cluster_smarthost_disabled: Postal uses the cluster smarthost, but no smarthost is configured in the NS8 settings (Email notifications).
settings.warning_cluster_smarthost_requires_auth: The cluster smarthost requires authentication: Postal relays cannot authenticate, it is not used as relay.
settings.warning_cluster_smarthost_implicit_tls: The cluster smarthost uses implicit TLS (port 465): Postal can send its own e-mails only with STARTTLS or without encryption.
settings.warning_smtp_certificate_missing: No TLS certificate for the SMTP host name yet: STARTTLS is offered once Traefik has one.
settings.smtp_server_description: Postal receives the messages of your applications and the incoming mail of its routes on this port. It is opened in the node firewall.
settings.smtp_hostname_helper: Leave empty to use the host name of the web interface
settings.smtp_port_helper: 2525 (default) does not collide with other mail servers; 25 receives mail from the Internet. Ports used by the Mail, mailcow or KumoMTA modules of this node are refused
settings.smtp_tls_tooltip: Offer STARTTLS with the Traefik certificate of the SMTP host name. With Let's Encrypt enabled, the certificate is requested automatically.
settings.dns_records_description: Records to publish in the DNS for Postal. The DKIM record of the return path domain is printed by the command shown.
settings.node_public_address: public IP address of the node
settings.dkim_record_command: output of: runagent -m MODULE podman exec postal-app postal default-dkim-record
settings.default_maximum_delivery_attempts_helper: Attempts before a message is marked as failed
settings.default_maximum_hold_expiry_days_helper: Days a held message is kept before it expires
settings.default_suppression_list_automatic_remov: Days an address stays in the suppression list
settings.default_spam_threshold_helper: Default spam score at which a message is treated as spam
settings.default_spam_failure_threshold_helper: Default spam score at which a message is rejected
settings.helo_hostname_helper: Name used in HELO/EHLO towards other mail servers. Leave empty for the default
settings.ip_pools_description: IP pools let Postal send the mail of each server or domain from a chosen IP address. The pools and their addresses are created in the Postal web interface; the addresses must exist on this node.
settings.ip_pools_limits_description: Postal runs in a rootless pod: it can bind only the address the pod network gives it, usually the primary address of the node. An IP pool address the pod cannot bind makes the deliveries fail with a connection error. Use the primary address, or several addresses only after checking the pod network of your node.
settings.relays_description: Send every outgoing message through these SMTP relays instead of the MX servers of the recipients. Postal relays have no authentication: the relay must accept the messages from the address of this node.
settings.relay_via_cluster_smarthost_tooltip: Use the smarthost of the NS8 settings (Email notifications) as the first relay. It must accept mail without authentication.
settings.cluster_smarthost_disabled: No smarthost is configured in the NS8 settings (Email notifications)
settings.cluster_relay_provider: Offer Postal as smarthost of the cluster
settings.cluster_relay_provider_tooltip: List Postal among the mail servers of the NS8 Email notifications settings. NS8 sends to port 25 without authentication.
settings.cluster_relay_provider_note: Requires the SMTP port 25. In the Postal web interface, create an SMTP-IP credential for the cluster network {network} in the mail server that sends the cluster e-mails.
settings.app_smtp_description: SMTP server for the e-mails Postal sends itself: invitations, password resets, notifications.
settings.oidc_description: Log in to Postal with an OpenID Connect provider, like Keycloak, authentik or ZITADEL.
settings.oidc_redirect_uri_description: Register this redirect URI in the client of the provider:
settings.oidc_preset_helper: Fills the issuer URL: complete it with the realm or application name
settings.oidc_discovery_tooltip: Read the endpoints from .well-known/openid-configuration of the issuer
settings.oidc_local_authentication_tooltip: Users with a password can still log in with it. It can be disabled only while OpenID Connect is enabled.
settings.inspection_description: Postal can inspect the messages with rspamd, SpamAssassin or ClamAV. Enter the address of an existing service, reachable from this node.
settings.dns_names_description: Names Postal gives to its users for the DNS records of their domains. Leave empty to derive them from the host name.
settings.web_server_max_threads_helper: Maximum threads of the web server
settings.worker_threads_helper: Threads of the worker that delivers the messages
settings.main_db_pool_size_helper: Must not be lower than the threads
settings.port_reserved: Port reserved for the web interface
settings.mail_module_on_node: Port used by another mail module of the node ({value})
settings.port_in_use: Port in use by another service of the node
settings.below_spam_threshold: Must not be lower than the spam threshold
settings.invalid_host: Invalid host name or IP address: {value}
settings.cluster_smarthost_requires_auth: The cluster smarthost requires authentication: Postal relays cannot authenticate
settings.provider_requires_port_25: NS8 sends to port 25: set the SMTP port to 25
settings.local_authentication_required: Enable OpenID Connect before disabling local logins: nobody could log in
settings.pool_below_threads: Must not be lower than the web server and worker threads
settings.smtp_port_conflict: Port {port} is used by {module} on this node: saving will be refused. Choose another port, or move {module} to another node.
settings.smtp_port_25: Postal receives the mail of the Internet for its routes and return path on port 25. Point the MX records to this node, and make sure no other mail server of the node uses port 25.
settings.track_domains_description: Postal tracks opens and clicks on the track domains of its mail servers (CNAME to {track}). Each one gets a Traefik route to Postal, with a Let's Encrypt certificate when it is enabled. The list is refreshed every 5 minutes.
settings.no_track_domains: No track domain in Postal yet: add them in the web interface of Postal, in the settings of a mail server.
settings.track_status_pending: Certificate pending: check the DNS record
settings.worker_host_network: Deliver with the network of the node
settings.worker_host_network_tooltip: Run the Postal worker, which delivers the messages, outside the pod with the network of the node (--network=host), still rootless.
settings.worker_host_network_description: Off (default): the worker runs in the pod and sends from the primary address only. On: it can bind every address of the node, so IP pools can use several addresses. It reaches MariaDB through its unix socket, no database port is opened.
settings.worker_host_network_tradeoff_description: With the network of the node, the worker shares the loopback interface of the node: it can reach the services that listen on 127.0.0.1 of the node, such as the other modules, and a flaw in Postal would reach them too. Postal still refuses webhooks to private and loopback addresses unless allowed_request_destinations lists them.
settings.rspamd_container_tooltip: An rspamd container in the pod inspects the messages for Postal. It replaces an external rspamd.
settings.rspamd_webui_tooltip: Publish the rspamd web interface on https://<Postal host name>/rspamd through Traefik. The rspamd password is asked for every request.
settings.clamav_container_tooltip: A ClamAV container in the pod scans the messages for Postal. It replaces an external ClamAV.
settings.clamav_memory_description: ClamAV needs about 1 GB of memory, and downloads its virus signatures before it answers: the first scans are skipped until then.
settings.rspamd_container_required: Enable rspamd in the module first
settings.rspamd_path_in_use: The /rspamd path of this host name is already used by another route
settings.rspamd_container_and_external: Disable the external rspamd: the rspamd of the module replaces it
settings.clamav_container_and_external: Disable the external ClamAV: the ClamAV of the module replaces it
